changes.summary: Indication now says ONLY and adds the LVEF <= 40% limit, and states that safety and efficacy are not established in pediatric patients or in HFpEF.

Dosing becomes a table by population: titration to 40mg after 4 weeks, 5mg once daily in severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min, no dialysis), dialysis contraindicated, and a 5mg limit with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors.
New warning on hypoglycemia in patients with diabetes who take insulin or an oral antidiabetic agent.
Cross reference now points to the dosing table in section 2.2.
Titration to 40mg moves to 6 weeks, severe renal impairment (eGFR < 30 mL/min, no dialysis) becomes 2.5mg once daily, and the table is replaced by a list.
New section: with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor, no more than 2.5mg once daily whatever the kidney function.
Cross reference now points to doses by eGFR in section 2.2.
